title_en: The Stance of Prominent Sunni Scholars on Anthropomorphism and Attributive Divine Attributes
description_en: The stance of prominent Sunni scholars on anthropomorphism and attributive divine attributes. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: An exploration of how major Sunni scholars have historically addressed issues of anthropomorphism and the interpretation of attributive divine texts.
